outcome: Incidence of obstetric anal sphincter injuries (OASIS)
cohort: Women who delivered vaginally at an Australian tertiary hospital before and after the implementation of the 'Please Squeeze' perineal guarding technique
finding: The introduction of the 'Please Squeeze' perineal guarding technique was associated with a significant reduction in OASIS rates across all vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: The incidence of OASIS decreased by 20% for both spontaneous vaginal deliveries and assisted vaginal deliveries after the implementation of the 'Please Squeeze' technique.
